meaning.rw: Hagarara utange inzira. (Icyapa STOP kizasimbura buhoro buhoro icyapa B.2b.)
meaning.en: Stop and give way. (The STOP sign replacing B.2b.)
meaning.fr: Arrêt et cédez le passage. (Le panneau STOP remplaçant B.2b.)

source.document: Amategeko y'Umuhanda (Ibyapa): Vienna Convention on Road Signs and Signals (1968)

meaning.rw: Ahegereye igice cy'umuhanda gikorwamo imirimo.
meaning.en: Road works. Warns of works on the carriageway ahead.
meaning.fr: Travaux. Annonce des travaux sur la chaussée.

source.document: Amategeko y'Umuhanda (Ibyapa): Vienna Convention on Road Signs and Signals (1968)

meaning.rw: Umuhanda ubisikanirwamo: imodoka zigenda mu byerekezo byombi.
meaning.en: Two-way traffic. Traffic ahead moves in both directions.
meaning.fr: Circulation dans les deux sens. La circulation venant en face se fait dans les deux sens.

source.document: Amategeko y'Umuhanda (Ibyapa): Vienna Convention on Road Signs and Signals (1968)

meaning.rw: Ikoni ibumoso : Ahegereye ikoni ryateza ibyago ibumoso ( Virage à gauche : approche d’ un virage dangereux à gauche)
meaning.en: Left bend. Warns of a dangerous bend to the left.
meaning.fr: Virage à gauche. Annonce un virage dangereux vers la gauche.

source.document: Vienna Convention on Road Signs and Signals (1968)

meaning.rw: Ikoni iburyo : Ahegereye ikoni ryateza ibyago iburyo Virage à droite approche d’un village dangereux à droite
meaning.en: Right bend. Warns of a dangerous bend to the right.
meaning.fr: Virage à droite. Annonce un virage dangereux vers la droite.

source.document: Vienna Convention on Road Signs and Signals (1968)

meaning.rw: Amakoni abiri cyangwa uruhererekane rw’ amakoni arenga abiri irya mbere riri ibumoso (Double virage ou succession de plus de deux virages, le premier à gauche.)
meaning.en: Double bend, first left. Warns of two or more bends, first to the left.
meaning.fr: Double virage, le premier à gauche. Annonce deux virages ou plus, le premier à gauche.

source.document: Vienna Convention on Road Signs and Signals (1968)

meaning.rw: Amakoni abiri cyangwa uruhererekane rw’ amakoni arenga abiri irya mbere riri iburyo . (Double virage ou succession de plus de deux virages, le premier à droite.)
meaning.en: Double bend, first right. Warns of two or more bends, first to the right.
meaning.fr: Double virage, le premier à droite. Annonce deux virages ou plus, le premier à droite.

source.document: Vienna Convention on Road Signs and Signals (1968)

meaning.rw: Akamanuko gashobora gutera ibyago: Icyigereranyo gishobora kuzuzwa n’ iyerekana ry’ ingano ry’ agacuri ku ijana. (Descente dangereuse)
meaning.en: Steep descent. Warns of a dangerous downhill gradient.
meaning.fr: Descente dangereuse. Annonce une forte pente descendante.

source.document: Vienna Convention on Road Signs and Signals (1968)

meaning.rw: Inkomane, gutambuka mbere hakurikijwe amategeko rusange yo gutambuka mbere . A.21ª : Inkomane aho umuhanda urasukira ibumoso mu mfuruka yenda kuba igororotse (Gutambuka mbere hakurikijwe amategeko rusange yo gutambuka mbere.)
meaning.en: Priority crossing. Give way according to the general priority rules.
meaning.fr: Intersection avec priorité. Cédez le passage selon les règles générales de priorité.

source.document: Vienna Convention on Road Signs and Signals (1968)

meaning.rw: Ntihanyurwa (nta kinyabiziga kihanyura)
meaning.en: No entry. No entry for all vehicles.
meaning.fr: Sens interdit. Accès interdit à tout véhicule.

source.document: Vienna Convention on Road Signs and Signals (1968)

meaning.rw: Birabujijwe ku binyabiziga ibyo ari byo byose kugenda bidasize hagati yabyo umwanya nibura ungana n’intera yerekanwe n’ikimenyetso (muri metero);
meaning.en: Minimum distance. Keep at least the distance shown between vehicles.
meaning.fr: Distance minimale. Laissez au moins la distance indiquée entre les véhicules.

source.document: Vienna Convention on Road Signs and Signals (1968)

meaning.rw: Birabujijwe gukata (mu cyerekezo kerekanwa n’akaranga-cyerekezo);
meaning.en: No turning in the direction shown.
meaning.fr: Interdiction de tourner dans la direction indiquée.

source.document: Vienna Convention on Road Signs and Signals (1968)

meaning.rw: Birabujijwe guhindukira;
meaning.en: No U-turn. U-turns are prohibited.
meaning.fr: Demi-tour interdit. Les demi-tours sont interdits.

source.document: Vienna Convention on Road Signs and Signals (1968)

meaning.rw: Birabujijwe kunyura ku binyabiziga byose uretse ibinyamitende
meaning.en: No overtaking. Overtaking is prohibited.
meaning.fr: Dépassement interdit. Il est interdit de dépasser.

source.document: Vienna Convention on Road Signs and Signals (1968)

meaning.rw: Birabujijwe kunyura ku kindi kinyabiziga (ibibujijwe ni kimwe n’ibyo ku kimenyetso C.13a ariko bikareba ibinyabiziga byagenewe gutwara ibicuruzwa kandi bifite uburemere Ntarengwa bwemewe bwa toni 3.5, akapa nyongera gashyirwa munsi y’ikimenyetso C.13b gashobora kwerekana muri toni, ubundi burebure ntarengwa bwemewe icyo kimenyetsKibuza kurenga);
meaning.en: No overtaking by trucks. Overtaking by goods vehicles is prohibited.
meaning.fr: Dépassement interdit aux camions. Interdit aux véhicules de transport de marchandises.

source.document: Vienna Convention on Road Signs and Signals (1968)

meaning.rw: Umuvuduko ntarengwa ugar ukira ku werekanwa n’ikimenyetso (mu birometero ku isaha) akapa nyongera gashyizwe munsi y’ikimenyetso C.14 gishobora kwerekana uburemere muri toni, no kuba gusa ibinyabiziga bifite u buremere ntarengwa bwemewe burenga uburemere bwerekanwa);
meaning.en: Speed limit. Maximum speed as shown (km/h).
meaning.fr: Vitesse limitée. Vitesse maximale indiquée (km/h).

source.document: Vienna Convention on Road Signs and Signals (1968)

meaning.rw: Birabujijwe kuvuza amahoni (keretse iyo ari ukwirinda impanuka)
meaning.en: No horn. Sounding the horn is prohibited.
meaning.fr: Avertisseur sonore interdit. Il est interdit de klaxonner.

source.document: Vienna Convention on Road Signs and Signals (1968)

meaning.rw: Birabujijwe gutambuka udahagaze akanya gato (byaba bitewe n’uko ari hafi ya gasutamo,byaba bitewe n’indi mpamvu yerekanwa n’ikimenyetso C.16 mu mwanya w’amagambo GASUTAMO);
meaning.en: Customs. No passing without stopping for a customs check.
meaning.fr: Douane. Passage interdit sans s'arrêter au contrôle douanier.

source.document: Vienna Convention on Road Signs and Signals (1968)

meaning.rw: Iherezo ry’ibibuzwa byose mu karere ku binyabiziga bigenda (cyerekana ko aho ibibuzwa byerekanwe mbere ,n’ibyapa bibuzwa ku binyabiziga bigenda biba bitagikurikizwa)
meaning.en: End of all local restrictions for moving vehicles.
meaning.fr: Fin de toutes les interdictions locales pour les véhicules en mouvement.

source.document: Vienna Convention on Road Signs and Signals (1968)

meaning.rw: Iherezo ry’umudugudu ( urugero rw’icyapa cyerekana iherezo ry’umudugudu) 0.8 D. IBINDI BYAPA ( SIGNAUX DIVERS )
meaning.en: End of the built-up area (village).
meaning.fr: Fin d'agglomération (village).

source.document: Vienna Convention on Road Signs and Signals (1968)

meaning.rw: Inzira y’abanyamaguru (cyerekana abanyamaguru n’abayobozi aho inzira y’abanyamaguru itangirira)
meaning.en: Pedestrian crossing. Location of a pedestrian crossing.
meaning.fr: Passage pour piétons. Emplacement d'un passage pour piétons.

source.document: Vienna Convention on Road Signs and Signals (1968)

meaning.rw: Ibitaro (cyereka abayobozi b’ibinyabiziga ko bakwiye kwitonda iyo bageze hafi y’amavuriro cyane cyane iyo bakirinda gutera ur usaku bakoresheje amahoni cyangwa imyuka ivubuka muri moteri)
meaning.en: Hospital. Take care near this area.
meaning.fr: Hôpital. Redoublez de prudence à proximité.

source.document: Vienna Convention on Road Signs and Signals (1968)

meaning.rw: Icyerekezo kimwe (iyo giteye ku buryo nyanguni ku murongo ugabanya umuhanda mo kabiri,cyemeza ko abagenzi banyura mu nzira y’icyerekezo kimwe)
meaning.en: One-way street. One-way traffic straight ahead.
meaning.fr: Sens unique. Circulation à sens unique tout droit.

source.document: Vienna Convention on Road Signs and Signals (1968)

meaning.rw: Icyerekezo kimwe (iyo giteye ku buryo buteganye n’ umurongo ugabanya umuhanda mo kabiri ,cyemeza ko umuhanda ukurikiye icyerekezo cy’akaranga cyerekezo ari icyerekezo kimwe)
meaning.en: One-way traffic.
meaning.fr: Circulation à sens unique.

source.document: Vienna Convention on Road Signs and Signals (1968)

meaning.rw: Inzira idakomeza (cyerekana ko inzira giteyeho mu ntangiriro idakomeza)
meaning.en: Dead end. No through road.
meaning.fr: Impasse. Voie sans issue.

source.document: Vienna Convention on Road Signs and Signals (1968)

meaning.rw: Umuhanda urombeje w’ibice byinshi (cyerekana ahantu amategeko yo kugendera mu muhanda urombereje w’ibice byinshi atangirira gukurikizwa)
meaning.en: Motorway. Start of the motorway.
meaning.fr: Autoroute. Début de l'autoroute.

source.document: Vienna Convention on Road Signs and Signals (1968)

meaning.rw: Iherezo ry’umuhanda urombereje w’ibice byinshi (cyerekana aho amategeko yihariye yo kugendera mu muhanda urombereje w’ibice byinshi atangikurikizwa)
meaning.en: End of motorway. End of the motorway.
meaning.fr: Fin d'autoroute.

source.document: Vienna Convention on Road Signs and Signals (1968)

meaning.rw: Icyerekezo gitegetswe (gitegeka buri kinyabiziga gukurikiza icyerekezo cyerekanwe n’uturanga - cyerekezo cyangwa kunyura muri kimwe mu byerekezo byerekanwe n’uturanga - cyerekezo)
meaning.en: Proceed straight. Mandatory direction: straight ahead.
meaning.fr: Direction obligatoire : tout droit.

source.document: Vienna Convention on Road Signs and Signals (1968)

meaning.rw: Icyerekezo gitegetswe (bisobanura kimwe n’icyapa D.1a , ikimenyetso cy’akaranga byerekezo bibiri, kigakoreshwa nyamara kugirango cyerekane ko ibinyabiziga bishobora kunyura hirya no hino y’inkomyi iri mu nzira nyabagendwa.
meaning.en: Mandatory direction (same as D.1a).
meaning.fr: Direction obligatoire (comme D.1a).

source.document: Vienna Convention on Road Signs and Signals (1968)

meaning.rw: Uguhigama; ( cyerekana mu nzira ifunganye igice cyagutse cy’inzira nyabagendwa gituma habaho guhagarika ikinyabiziga kugirango gihe umwanya ibinyabiziga biturutse imbere )
meaning.en: Pass on this side.
meaning.fr: Contournement obligatoire par ce côté.

source.document: Vienna Convention on Road Signs and Signals (1968)

meaning.rw: Akapa nyongera kerekana intera iri hagati y'icyapa n'ahantu hatangirira ibyago cyangwa amabwiriza.
meaning.en: Distance panel: distance from the sign to the hazard/zone.
meaning.fr: Panonceau de distance : distance entre le panneau et le danger ou la zone.

source.document: Vienna Convention on Road Signs and Signals (1968)

meaning.rw: Hoteri cyangwa ahari icumbi ry’abagenzi F 11 : Aho bafatira ifunguro F12 : Urunywero cyangwa urusamuriro. F 13 : Ahateganirijwe ururiro rw’abahisi F14 : Aho bahagurukira batembera ku maguru. F15 : Ikibanza cy’ingando
meaning.en: Hotel. Hotel or motel.
meaning.fr: Hôtel. Hôtel ou motel.

source.document: Vienna Convention on Road Signs and Signals (1968)

meaning.rw: Aho bafatira ifunguro (resitora).
meaning.en: Restaurant.
meaning.fr: Restaurant.

source.document: Vienna Convention on Road Signs and Signals (1968)

meaning.rw: Urunywero cyangwa urusamuriro (kawa/icyayi).
meaning.en: Refreshments / café.
meaning.fr: Rafraîchissements / café.

source.document: Vienna Convention on Road Signs and Signals (1968)

meaning.rw: Ahateganirijwe kuruhukira (ururiro rw'abahisi).
meaning.en: Rest / picnic area.
meaning.fr: Aire de repos / pique-nique.

source.document: Vienna Convention on Road Signs and Signals (1968)

meaning.rw: Aho bahagurukira batembera ku maguru.
meaning.en: Starting point for walks (pedestrians).
meaning.fr: Point de départ de promenades (piétons).

source.document: Vienna Convention on Road Signs and Signals (1968)
